defects.summary: POST /v1/refunds has no require_api_key dependency; destination and amount come from the request body and are paid from the settlement account with no bound, allowlist or vendor policy.

Settlement checks invoice.status == 'open', awaits the payment in a worker thread, and only then marks it paid; two concurrent settle calls both pass the check and pay the vendor twice (monthly cap is also read before either write).
Deposit verification matches the incoming payment by asset_code 'USDC' only, without the issuer, so a payment of a worthless self-issued USDC credits the customer balance.

decoys.why_safe: Seed comes from the environment as a SecretStr and is never returned; /healthz exposes only the public key.
Vendor payments are bound by policy.enforce_vendor_payment: vendor allowlist supplies the destination, amount is parsed and capped per invoice and per month.
Accounting webhook body is only accepted after an HMAC-SHA256 check with compare_digest in auth.verify_signature; it only records invoices and never pays.
